Director John Singleton confessed he "didn’t know anything" about directing when he started.
His producer, Steve Nicolaides, scheduled the shooting in total continuity, a very rarely attempted practice.
Singleton said he was learning to direct as the movie progressed, which he felt made the camerawork stronger.
He even added a line of dialogue, "I'm not getting old, I'm getting better," to reflect his growing confidence.
